title: basalt plugin check --json: the result of a check that passed
description: What basalt plugin check <name> --json prints, exit 0, when the entry started, answered initialize and health READY, and answered every sample it was sent. A check that fails prints no result: the reason goes to stderr and the exit code is 1, or a PLUGIN_REFUSED error body is printed when the installed copy is refused. Times are whole milliseconds, rounded. See CONTRACT.md, Plugins, What basalt plugin check sends.

initializeMs.description: How long starting or dialing the plugin's initialize took.

status.description: Always READY: any other answer fails the check.

hooks.description: One item per declared hook that was sent its sample, in hook name order. A hook with no sample yet (wire.detect, classify.suggest, wire.verdict) has no item.

lastSeq.description: feed.observe only: the lastSeq the plugin answered, which is the sample's last seq.
